prompts.barracks-atlas:
Use case: ui-mockup game sprite asset. The reference shows the APPROVED game's visual target. Create a production SPRITE ATLAS, NOT another game screenshot. TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, no sky, no scenery, no labels, no numbers, no UI, no drop-shadow rectangle. Exactly 15 isolated stylized 3D palace barracks in a perfectly regular FIVE COLUMN × THREE ROW grid on a 1600x1440 transparent canvas. Each equal cell320x480 has generous transparent margins, one whole building centered horizontally, ground-contact baseline exactly90% of cell height, all objects entirely within their cells, no dividers. Same camera for all: elevated front view at ~35 degrees, soft sunlight from upper-left, baked ambient occlusion, beautiful hand-polished white ivory stone, fine champagne-gold edging and lush green miniature shrubs ONLY at base. Roof jewel enamel, crisp silhouettes legible at80px tall, reference-level premium artistry. No existing company branding.
Columns consistently:1 NEUTRAL white ivory roof with gray shield medallion;2 EMERALD roof with four-sided diamond medallion;3 CORAL RED roof with triangular medallion;4 SAPPHIRE BLUE roof with round medallion;5 AMETHYST PURPLE roof with square medallion. Every row repeats those5 colors in exactly that order. Walls stay IVORY for all teams, only roofs and narrow banners colored. Medallions blank shapes, no text.
Row1 LEVEL1: the slim cylindrical barracks from reference, single domed conical roof, tiny golden spire, one small arched doorway and base steps; height68% of cell.
Row2 LEVEL2: visibly wider fortified version with a second architectural tier and two small buttresses/side alcoves, same footprint and camera, height78% of cell.
Row3 LEVEL3: finest upgraded keep with tall central jewel dome, two small side turrets, more gold structural trim, height86% of cell. Make upgrade silhouettes genuinely different but coherent same family.
Keep every sprite isolated, single consistent ground plane, genuinely transparent pixels between/around all15 buildings. No checkerboard printed into the art, no white sheet background. No troop counter circles or level badges; application renders text separately.
prompts.citadel: Use case: ui-mockup game sprite asset. Reference is approved style only. Generate ONE isolated central neutral citadel on a genuinely transparent alpha background, square1024x1024. Beautiful ivory limestone cylindrical palace with tall central crown-shaped golden parapet, three elegant small roof spires, tiny arched windows, broad welcoming gate and marble stairway, champagne-gold edge trim, sparse miniature green ivy at base. Centered, full building visible with15% empty transparent margins. Ground-contact anchor at x50% y90%. prompts.battlefield:
Use case: stylized-concept environment game asset. Use the reference game's floating sky kingdom as visual material/style reference. Generate ONLY the large floating ISLAND TERRAIN as a reusable empty game board, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha outside the island. 1400x1400 square canvas. Very high camera looking down at shallow isometric angle, a nearly circular broad grassy top plateau occupying80% of image width and70% image height, gently foreshortened with front cliff/base taking lower20%. Ground plane is broad, flat and EMPTY for placing13 movable castle sprites and drawing arbitrary roads; keep its central80% short even green grass with subtle tiny flower patches, no distracting rocks. Edge rich with finely detailed low bushes, occasional small white-gold stone retaining blocks, layered pale limestone floating cliff, thin turquoise waterfalls descending off the lower and side edges, soft painted ambient occlusion and sunlit highlights. Tiny perimeter foliage creates polish; NONE of the foliage obscures large portions of playable plane. Keep an even calm ground background so white/gold roads drawn later are readable. Beautiful cohesive premium casual mobile3D art matching reference, no dark giant shadows.
ABSOLUTELY NO CASTLES, NO TOWERS, NO BUILDINGS, NO ROADS, NO PATHS, NO BRIDGES, NO UNITS, NO TEXT OR UI. Do not reproduce the reference battlefield layout. This must be a blank reusable terrain layer; transparent exterior, no sky, no checkered backdrop baked into pixels. Island fully in frame, 4% transparent margin, centered.
prompts.sky-backdrop: Use case: stylized-concept mobile game background. Use reference for exact art direction but remove all foreground gameplay and UI. One beautiful portrait1080x2340 seamless-feeling SKY BACKDROP for an ivory/gold fantasy floating-kingdom game. Saturated azure sky, white sunlit cumulus clouds, soft turquoise atmospheric mist, a few distant small floating limestone islands with delicate ivory-and-gold castles and long waterfalls along FAR LEFT and FAR RIGHT edges, tiny evergreen foliage. Beautiful stylized3D hand-painted polish, warm upper-left sunshine and light depth haze. Middle60% deliberately calm sky and gentle cloud gradients so a separately-rendered foreground island, towers and soldiers will be clear. No main foreground island, no big hero building, no roads, no troops, no menus, no numbers, no labels, no logos. Top and bottom have soft cloud edges usable behind translucent UI. Rich atmospheric depth with restrained contrast; clear daylight not sunset. OPAQUE full canvas, crisp high-quality environment wallpaper matching the approved game's sky world.
